pages.text: $(italic)Scion of a forgotten god. Towers over mortal limits with massive health and divine abilities.$()$(br2)$(bold)Divine Body$() — $(item)+40% max HP$() (8 extra hearts). The tankiest race.$(br2)$(bold)Divine Fury$() — Activate Strength on command. 50s cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Phase$() — Phase through blocks briefly.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Raw Diet$() — Raw meat gives 2x nourishment. Cooked meat 1.5x.$(br2)$(bold)Cursed$() — $(warn)Fire burns 50% hotter. Nether sickens you.$() But you endure.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with a glass-cannon class — the +40% HP buys back what Archmage or Void Summoner gives up.$()
